plan: An enchanter support who heals, shields and cleanses his allies of crowd control.
aSurveiller: His R (Breath of Life). He heals his allies and removes all their crowd control: cast your crowd control after his R.
contrer: Cast your crowd control after his R: he removes it.
Engage him: he is very fragile.
His fireball (Q) knocks you back: avoid it.

sorts.P: His spells empower his allies' attacks.
sorts.Q: Fireball that knocks back and slows.
